base_root.advisory: Scheduling advisory: Review local task details against posted recommendations; consider useful transfers whenever patient completion requires supplies.

payload.content: Scripted source note from St_Marys_Center_Surgery: We previously moved one IV kit from St_Marys_Center to General_Hospital and back. The recorded source transfer credit totals 30. At source-exclusion handoff St_Marys_Center held two IV kits, General_Hospital held zero, and each hospital had one assigned pending Ward step requiring one kit. The runtime system prompt states the current transfer-credit rule. Recommendation: Send one kit safely between the two hospitals. Keep it there, request no return, then finish the assigned steps to complete patient care before considering any later transfers.
